qa_pairs.question: How many fuse positions are shown in the upper row of the power distribution box?
Where are connectors C100, C114, and C115 located?
qa_pairs.answer: Connectors C100, C114, and C115 are located on the underside of the printed circuit board

qa_pairs.question: What component is located in position K10?
qa_pairs.answer: K10 is the Wiper Control Unit

qa_pairs.question: Which relay is designated as K8?
qa_pairs.answer: K8 is the Fog Light Relay

qa_pairs.question: What fuse positions are shown in the lower row of the power distribution box?
qa_pairs.answer: The lower row shows fuse positions 16 through 30

qa_pairs.question: What special components are noted as being part of the printed circuit board?
qa_pairs.answer: The low beam check relay and relay noise suppressors are part of the printed circuit board

qa_pairs.question: Which direction is indicated as the front of the car in this diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The front of the car is indicated by an arrow pointing to the left
